Aldor vs. Scryer for Protection Paladin Tank in Phase 3
For Protection Paladins, the stat differences between the blue shoulder enchants for each faction are pretty marginal, with Scryers  barely winning out vs Aldors . The main differences between the factions come in the early game with regard to quest rewards and rep vendor items that can help you gear up much faster for tanking heroic dungeons and Phase 2 raids. In terms of reputation gain, The Scryers tend to be an easier faction to gain reputation with, so in that respect, Scryers are the superior option for those who want to obtain their shoulder enchants as quickly as possible.

enchant_guidance.label: Aldor vs. Scryer for Protection Paladin Tank in Phase 3
enchant_guidance.text: At this point in the game, the Aldor spell power enchant  also offers better threat stats over the Scryer alternative , giving a clear overall advantage to Aldor. Although this is not a game-breaking choice for those who went Scryer early on for their Phase 1 items.
